description: The UI style guide: type scale, spacing system, component states, iconography rules, interface motion. Sits between the art bible and the screen flow, and is what every UI asset is checked against.
when_to_use: interface elements look inconsistent across screens
a component library or design system has to be written down
type, spacing or icon rules are undecided
avoid_when: the screen structure itself is still unsettled
the request is to produce specific UI images
